objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: All five pull_request/push and non-PR workflows were discovered and given an explicit trigger decision, and the required `unit-tests` check was correctly handled with always-run-plus-internal-skip semantics (green status preserved) instead of a workflow-level path filter that would strand merges.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each path list is tied to that workflow's own sources, configs, and its own file rather than a catch-all, but for a Node project running `npm ci` both `tests.yml` and `deploy.yml` list `package.json` while omitting `package-lock.json`, a real dependency their steps consume.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: Correctly left the schedule-only and issue-driven workflows and the branch-protection ruleset untouched, but overreached by creating a brand-new `AGENTS.md` (and adding a `workflow_dispatch` trigger) that the audit did not call for.
